title: Apple Says OpenAI May Have Destroyed Evidence in Trade-Secrets Fight
dek: Apple is seeking expedited discovery after alleging that a former employee’s MacBook contained discussions about deleting forensic data relevant to its case against OpenAI.
socialCaption: Apple is seeking expedited discovery in its trade-secrets suit against OpenAI, alleging a former employee’s MacBook included discussions about destroying forensic data. The procedural fight could shape the case before its core claims are tested.
